title: Opening another profile's exhibition by its address (Business active, Personal exhibition) EMPTIES it
summary: Reproduced independently by the coordinator (CRW-012): 7 items, 7 links and 7 layout entries became 0 although the page only said 'Exhibition not found'. The control visit on the matching profile changed nothing.
statusNote: batch 1 (a9e23fb); historical attribution of one empty exhibition unresolved, see DEFECT-STATUS.md

title: Private notes and 'Recorded cost basis' flow into public/buyer-facing text
summary: Marketplace listing copy contains the cost-basis line and the private internal note; 'Generate listing copy' puts the private note in its draft and Accept saves it as the public description; the public /share page then shows it to a signed-out visitor.

title: Cancelling an auction leaves a previously private item public
summary: Starting an auction makes the item public; Cancel Auction does not undo it (is_public stays true).
statusNote: batch 1 (37ab253); remembering prior visibility deferred (needs a stored field)

title: SIMULATED interrupted connection: when the sign-out request fails, the page shows the login screen and gives no error while the session continues
summary: These rows were made with the sign-out request REFUSED by the audit, so they do not show that sign-out fails in normal use. A REAL sign-out of a synthetic QA session was verified separately and PASSED (CRW-025, CRW-026: session cleared, refresh token revoked, old session refused in a clean browser). Only the failed-request case is a finding: no error is shown and the session remains.

title: A public exhibition with an alias still hands the real profile id to anyone reading its row; alias/shelf-style edits do not autosave; Announce is refused by the database
summary: Direct read of the public row exposes profile_id despite an alias; the owner's insert into exhibition_events is refused by row-level security while the button reads 'Announced' (an unapplied migration is possible).

title: Silent data loss in Add / Import / Halls
summary: Import 'Undo last' says it undid items that stay in the account; 'Skip exact titles' imports duplicates in a clean browser; approving an AI draft is not saved until /vault is opened; Bulk takes 60 of 62 files without saying; /capture loses typed data on leaving; 'Save as Hall' creates nothing and opens 'Exhibition not found'.
statusNote: batch 3 (D-01, D-02, D-06 to D-10): all 10 rows verified on production (ADD-272 through the real Vault Matches tile)

title: Writes that look saved but are lost (Goals, profile fields)
summary: A goal target above ~2.1 billion shows 'saved' and is lost on reload; Create/Delete goal while the connection fails shows success but the database disagrees; an empty display name and bad usernames are saved.
statusNote: batch 3 (D-03, D-04, D-05, goal ownership): GIN-066, GIN-068, GIN-070 closed; the six profile-validation rows (ACC-381, 796, 390, 811, 395, 819) stay open with RC-28

title: Admin screens (/admin/themes, /studio) are shown to signed-out visitors and non-admins
summary: The theme manager with + New Theme / Edit / Delete is visible to everyone; /studio shows its setup screen. By reading the table policy, writes need an admin role, and no write was attempted. Exposure, not a confirmed data-loss path.

title: Printable insurance packet is a blank white page; item-sheet and inventory prints are unreadable
summary: A print rule in the page ([style*="--topnav"]{display:none}) matches the <html> element (it carries --topnav-shift), hiding the whole document, on screen and in print. Item-sheet print has near-white text on white; the top bar prints on four pages. NOTE: the coordinator's earlier production check of this page only confirmed the text existed, which could not detect this.

title: Avatar upload is refused by storage for ordinary users
summary: Every avatar upload fails with a raw row-level-security message (verified with the QA login directly).

title: Bulk scan quota function refuses profiles whose id differs from the user id
summary: bulk_scan_status answers 'not authorized' unless profile id = user id; 17 of 39 real profiles (all 3 Business, 14 Personal) have different ids. Effect: no quota ticker; 'Scan with AI' says all scans are used without calling the AI.

title: Lounge subject boards call the leaderboard function with the wrong argument name
summary: registryModel.ts sends {subject_name}; the current database function takes p_subject, so every subject board 404s and reads '0 collectors'. The function works when called correctly.

title: Header search ignores its query; Command Palette finds almost nothing
summary: The URL gets ?q= but the Vault ignores it ('zzzznomatch' still lists all items). Palette typed 'goals', 'discover', 'insurance', 'lounge' etc. finds nothing; only 'sold' and 'settings' work.

title: Install banner covers controls on phones (browser-emulated)
summary: The Add to Home Screen banner covers the Quick Add shutter, the Bulk 'Add all' button, landing-page footer links and tag chips; a tap hits the banner.

title: Exhibitions page on a phone opens a details sheet over ~74% of the screen that cannot be closed
summary: Filter, sort, Tools and Create sit under it in the first view.

title: Camera / image / PSA controls fail silently
summary: Refused Identify with AI, Quick Add camera start failure, wrong-type photos and empty import files give no clear message; 'Use Full Photo' and crop Cancel do the wrong thing; PSA 'Look up' does nothing visible; mouse drag-reorder of photos fails.

title: Values: letters, blanks and negatives become money; negative values accepted; numbers parsed wrongly
summary: 'abc' saves $0 or blank under a green Saved; blanking an asking price saves $0; negative cost/price/value saved; '1e3' becomes 13 and '1,5' becomes 15; auction accepts a negative starting bid and a Buy It Now below the reserve.

title: Sales ledger and profit figures break the value rule or disagree
summary: A sale with no cost reads as pure profit; a recorded $0 cost shows a dash; a sale made from For Sale shows its sold price missing and -100%; the item page and the Sold card show different profits for one sale; the Pricing card shows an explicit $0 value as '—'.

title: Totals and counts disagree between Insurance, packet, reports, PDFs and Insights
summary: Insurance and packet list the 5 sold items, the reports do not; totals $1,431 vs $1,226 vs $1,443; Vault Insurance PDF says 44 items where 36 belong; exclusions are device-only; weekly gap count 31 vs 30; three pages report stale prices as three numbers.
statusNote: batch 2 (5ac1d30): GIN-087, GIN-240, GIN-243, GIN-260, GIN-097, GIN-098, VLT-297 closed; GIN-095 deferred (migration), GIN-092/GIN-155/VLT-353 open

title: Goal progress and labels wrong; goal type guessed from words
summary: Direct URL shows every goal at 0%; Value/Sell/Exhibition goals count items, not dollars/duplicates/exhibitions; 'Insurable Value' counts items; type inferred from name text ('bedroom' becomes Exhibition); 'Completed This Year' has no year logic; 'View set'/'Review items' silently add a wishlist entry; Delete has no confirmation.

title: A failed load is shown as an empty collection (or stays on 'Loading…')
summary: With the connection refused, Insights says 'No items yet', Activity/Alerts 'No activity yet', Goals 'No goals yet', reports an empty collection, Discover 'No public exhibitions yet', Upcoming/Watchlist/Home show empty or no stale notice; unknown club and the stream page for another user's item stay on 'Loading…' forever.

title: Direct load in a clean browser shows zeros until the Vault has been opened
summary: /museum shows every card as 0 items / $0, /museum/new 0 current exhibitions, /vault/print 0 items, /vault/readiness 'No for-sale listings', /portfolio/insurance and /reports/weekly zeros, Settings export is a 64-byte empty file, sync line 'Out of sync - Local 0, Cloud 31'.

title: Watchlist, Favorites and Market show invented or wrong numbers and broken links
summary: A wish's 'Current Value' is target x 1.18; watched items show a made-up Target Price and totals computed from them; Market cards link to /v/undefined (raw database error) and rank/total by current value not asking price; Favorites counts differ.

title: Insights/Vault links and drill-downs lead to the wrong or an empty place
summary: Breakdown and cost rows link to an empty 'Misc' page; 'View all movers', '+ Add note', 'Open Exhibitions' go to plain /vault; unknown universe/slug silently shows Misc; empty gallery pages say 'Your vault is empty'; the universe drill-down defaults to a 30-day window.

title: Sort and Halls arithmetic wrong
summary: Gain sort mishandles value-with-no-cost and explicit $0; default Wall view says 'Newest' but is A to Z; Halls ignore tax/shipping/fees and offer sold items; 'Recent' goal sort is not newest-first.

title: Buttons that do something other than their label
summary: Exhibition list Duplicate/Export PDF/'View public page' only open the editor; Watchlist '+ Add Watch' goes to Add Item; 'Add to Insurance' only opens a print dialog; 'The Flip' links go to Discover; sign-out-all has no confirmation; 'Unlock All' clears the form; Universes-displayed setting is ignored by most pages; 'Switch app theme? Yes' changes nothing; '/auth/confirmed' says the email is confirmed with no code.

title: Counters and messages that cannot be believed
summary: Exhibition view counter never increments for visitors; Upcoming date range edits the banner without refetching; signed-out Want says it could not save to your account; messages show 'Collector' for every partner and silently cut at 4,000 chars; expired invite says 'Link not available'; Bid History lists one bid twice.

title: Create/profile forms give poor or wrong validation
summary: Double-clicking Create makes two exhibitions; a disabled Create has no explanation; 140-char title accepted though the editor caps at 80; taken usernames give only a generic 'Failed to save'; Verify Age shows 'Verified' before Save.

title: Close / Escape does not close panels, dialogs and sheets
summary: Discover and Watchlist detail panels, Lounge composer, photo preview, Edit Photo dialog, Activity details panel Close/Dismiss.

title: Empty-result states missing when a filter matches nothing
summary: No-match search on Discover still lists all rooms; Watchlist and exhibitions filters show no message.

title: Small tap targets, off-screen feedback and sideways overflow on phones (browser-emulated)
summary: Targets under 44 px on item, Sales, Goals, builder and Events pages; 'Asking price saved' message off-screen; 2 px overflow on For Sale/Sold; Discover room card tap fills a panel 4,300 px down.

title: Misc. navigation and wording defects
summary: Footer 'Exhibitions' link goes to login; onboarding header links bounce silently; dead CGC link; Lounge drops show an all-day event a day early (US Pacific); /lounge-preview shows developer wording; 'Open Exhibitions' wrong targets elsewhere.

title: Legacy /api/vault/[id] accepts anonymous writes (reachable, not durable, not used)
summary: Probed with a synthetic payload only, after reading the code: POST/DELETE answer 200 to an anonymous caller; the route keeps items only in server process memory (no database or file), has no read endpoint, and nothing in the app calls it. Hygiene finding (unauthenticated memory use), not data exposure or loss.

title: Cosmetic: emoji icons (standing project rule), raw labels and placeholders
summary: /shop and /saved use emoji; avatar emoji tab; 'key' shown as avatar in Switch Profile; category label 'Tv'; raw POP_CULTURE headings on print; placeholder subtitle; 'insured items' wording.
